Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and a modern frontend framework, plus proficiency in a backend language frameworks Extensive hands-on experience using Git for version control, including branching strategies, pull requests, code reviews, and conflict resolution. Practical experience with relational data modeling, SQL, REST APIs, asynchronous processing and automated tests. An engineer who enjoys moving fast without compromising engineering quality Understanding of authentication, authorization, secure coding and collaborative code review. Ability to debug across the stack and explain technical choices in terms of usability, accuracy and maintainability. Useful additional experience Azure, Auth0, Three.js or other browser-based 3D tools; large data grids; SaaS permissions; construction, estimating or engineering software. How you will work in our startup Turn an unclear user need into a small, testable feature; discuss trade-offs early and adapt as feedback comes in. Share an example of working through ambiguity, responding to feedback or helping a small team deliver with limited resources. Develop scalable services and APIs using Spring, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and microservices architecture . Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and design principles. Participate in solution design, technical design reviews, code reviews, and architecture discussions. Troubleshoot complex application, integration, performance, and production issues. Develop unit and integration tests and ensure adequate automated test coverage. Support application modernization, technical-debt reduction, and continuous improvement initiatives. Work closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, QA, architects, DevOps engineers, and production support teams throughout the SDLC. AI-Enabled SDLC Actively use AI-assisted software engineering tools and Generative AI capabilities to accelerate development activities across the SDLC. Apply AI to improve requirements understanding, solution design, code generation, code refactoring, unit-test creation, test-data generation, defect analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting . Identify repetitive engineering activities that can be automated or accelerated through AI agents, reusable prompts, workflows, or engineering accelerators . Contribute reusable AI-enabled engineering assets, patterns, and best practices that can be adopted by other development teams. Measure and demonstrate improvements achieved through AI adoption, including engineering productivity, development cycle time, quality, automation, and reduction of repetitive manual effort. Strong experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot . Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs and microservices . Experience with persistence technologies such as JPA/Hibernate and relational databases. Strong understanding of SQL and database design concepts. Experience with build and dependency-management tools such as Maven or Gradle . Experience with automated unit and integration testing using technologies such as JUnit, Mockito, REST Assured, or equivalent frameworks . Experience with source-control and CI/CD practices using technologies such as Git and Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms . Understanding of containerized application development using Docker and exposure to Kubernetes or similar orchestration platforms. Experience developing or supporting applications deployed to a major cloud platform such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform . Strong knowledge of secure coding, application security, logging, monitoring, exception management, and production-support practices. AI & GenAI Skills Practical experience using Generative AI or AI coding assistants within software engineering activities. Ability to create effective prompts and provide sufficient technical context to AI tools for software-development use cases. Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, unit-test generation, documentation, debugging, code explanation, and engineering productivity . Understanding of the limitations and risks of AI-generated code and the importance of human review and validation. Exposure to technologies such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, or comparable enterprise GenAI platforms is preferred. Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving capabilities. Ability to independently own complex development assignments from design through production implementation. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across business, development, QA, architecture, infrastructure, and support teams. About you Preferred Qualifications Experience with enterprise application modernization and migration from legacy or monolithic architectures to microservices and cloud-native architectures .
